widget.CollisionEnergy.title: Collision energy and nuclear thickness
widget.CollisionEnergy.view: Side view of two Pb nuclei just before contact, beam axis horizontal. Height is the 14 fm diameter; width is the Lorentz-contracted thickness (drawn at least 2 px wide).
widget.CollisionEnergy.note: γ = √s_NN / (2 m_N), m_N ≈ 0.938 GeV; thickness = 14 fm / γ. The stopping curve, f = 1 / (1 + (√s_NN / 15 GeV)²), is a smooth schematic, not a fit to data: real stopping depends on the system and observable.
widget.ImpactParameter.title: Impact parameter and overlap
widget.ImpactParameter.view: End view (beam out of the page) of two discs of radius 7 fm. The overlap lens holds the participants; the rest are spectators. The reaction plane is horizontal.
widget.ImpactParameter.note: Sharp-edge discs, uniform density. A = 2R² arccos(b/2R) − (b/2)√(4R² − b²); N_part ≈ 416·A/(πR²); centrality ≈ (b/2R)² × 100 %. ε = (⟨y²⟩ − ⟨x²⟩)/(⟨y²⟩ + ⟨x²⟩), found by sampling the lens uniformly. Geometric estimates, not a Glauber calculation.
widget.FlowDemo.title: From eccentricity to elliptic flow
widget.FlowDemo.note: v₂ ≈ k·κ·ε with k ≈ 0.2, a rough hydrodynamic response (the real value depends on energy, viscosity and particle type); κ from 0 (no rescattering) to 1. Angles are sampled from dN/dφ ∝ 1 + 2v₂ cos 2φ, so statistical wiggles are expected. The short axis of the source lies in the reaction plane (φ = 0).
widget.EnergyScan.title: Energy scan: where the freeze-out point lands
widget.EnergyScan.view: Phase-diagram plane: temperature versus baryon chemical potential, in MeV.
widget.EnergyScan.note: μ_B = 1.308 GeV / (1 + 0.273 GeV⁻¹ · √s_NN); T_ch = 0.166 − 0.139 μ_B² − 0.053 μ_B⁴ (GeV, μ_B in GeV). Parametrisation of freeze-out fits by Cleymans, Oeschler, Redlich and Wheaton, Phys. Rev. C 73, 034905 (2006). The critical-point region is a hypothesis, not a result: its existence and location are open.
widget.BetheBloch.title: Energy loss versus momentum
widget.BetheBloch.close: Within 10 % of each other at this momentum: {pairs}.
widget.BetheBloch.separated: All five species differ by more than 10 % at this momentum.
widget.BetheBloch.view: Schematic, simplified Bethe–Bloch curves for charge-1 particles versus momentum, log–log.
widget.BetheBloch.note: Schematic, simplified Bethe–Bloch: −dE/dx ∝ (1/β²)[ln(2 m_e c² β²γ² / I) − β² − δ/2], I = 188 eV (argon-like), scaled so a minimum-ionising particle (βγ ≈ 3.5) equals 1. The density effect δ is modelled crudely so the curves level off at a plateau about 1.5 times the minimum, as in a gas detector.
